_comment: FORMAT (this _comment key is ignored by the tool). Keyed by app (Mighty | SPL | SPL-Secure); codeFields are fallback response-code keys, and each rule has match (host-path glob), codeField, successCodes and skip. Example: { "Mighty": { "codeFields": ["resultCode"], "rules": [ { "match": "*/rest/auth/login", "codeField": "resultCode", "successCodes": ["000000"], "skip": false } ] } }. Easiest: configure in the app (Rules editor > Save) and copy your ~/.traceguard/log-rules.json over this file. See README.md.
